name: oxford-command-center
description: The Brain — Oxford Real Assets internal command center (local-first live 2nd brain)
//devServerNote: dev:server (tsx watch) intermittently hangs before ever binding its port on this machine (~2/5 trials, 2026-07-08) — reproduced via preview_start and raw shell alike; npm --prefix cwd resolution and preview_start's process model were both ruled out as the cause via direct A/B testing. Root cause undetermined, likely transient resource contention on a machine that runs many concurrent node processes. dev:server:once (tsx, no watch) was 5/5 reliable across the same trials and is the launch.json default — no hot-reload, so restart manually after backend edits. See event_log.md 2026-07-08 for the full investigation.
//deployMirrorNote: deploy:mirror is a MANUAL, unbounded convenience script for a human at a terminal — it does NOT go through scripts/deploy-mirror.ps1 and has none of its hardening (no fetch/merge fast-forward, no Access-gate re-verification, no timeout on the wrangler deploy, no alerting). The registered hourly Windows Scheduled Task calls deploy-mirror.ps1 directly, never this script. Found 2026-07-29 (code-review follow-up to a deploy-mirror.ps1 hang incident): this script has the identical unbounded `npx wrangler pages deploy` call, left un-hardened deliberately rather than by oversight — repointing it at deploy-mirror.ps1 would silently add its git fast-forward-merge requirement and confidential-bake env vars to what is meant to be a quick manual deploy of whatever is currently checked out. If a human runs this and it hangs, Ctrl-C same as any manual command; it does not carry the scheduled task's silent-30-minute-kill risk because a human is watching.

scripts.build:mirror: npm run bake && npm run build
scripts.deploy:mirror: npm run build:mirror && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=ora-command-center --branch=main
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p functions/tsconfig.json
scripts.gate: npm run governance && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:dev-css && npm run check:css-tokens && npm run check:schema-drift && npm run test && npm run reconcile:snapshot && npm run reconcile && npm run reconcile:noi-crosscheck && npm run warehouse:verify && npm run warehouse:drift
scripts.gate:ci: npm run governance && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run check:dev-css && npm run check:css-tokens && npm run check:schema-drift && npm run test && npm run reconcile:snapshot && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
